sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे षडशीतितमः सर्गः ।। ८६ ।।
transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ṣaḍaśītitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 86 ।।

translations.english: Thus addressed by Vibhishana, the terrifier of foes, the great-souled one then beheld that dreadful, mighty and unassailable warrior, huge as a mountain, standing in his chariot.
